response.justification: The candidate lacks demonstrable experience with Java/Kotlin, JVM tooling, Spring ecosystem, or IDE internals — core requirements for this role. Their work centers on TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web/mobile apps, with only superficial Java exposure in early roles without evidence of enterprise framework or IDE tooling contributions.
strengths: Strong full-stack versatility across languages and domains
Proven track record in open-source tooling and developer education
Experience with CI/CD, testing frameworks, and dev-ops infrastructure
concerns: No evidence of Java/Kotlin enterprise IDE or JVM tooling development
Lacks demonstrated experience with Spring, Quarkus, or application server integration
Primary tech stack (TypeScript, DLang, Node.js) does not align with JVM-focused role
